verdict.rationale: Orrick's own country landing pages for the UK, Germany, France and India describe in-country venture, financing and M&A practices. Its global equity compensation group promises a single point of contact worldwide across jurisdictions, which directly supports expanding without hiring a second firm. Missing for 10: an explicit office list or count of qualified jurisdictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-border handoff; the India page is also framed around energy and infrastructure rather than startups.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm
